mapper.insert: insert into reminder_rule(user_id, title, content, type, interval_minutes, enabled, next_trigger_time, created_at) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{intervalMinutes}, #{enabled}, #{nextTriggerTime}, now())
mapper.select: select id, user_id, title, content, type, interval_minutes, enabled, next_trigger_time, created_at from reminder_rule where user_id = #{userId} order by id desc
select id, user_id, title, content, type, interval_minutes, enabled, next_trigger_time, created_at from reminder_rule where enabled = 1 and next_trigger_time <= #{now} order by id asc
